metadata.title: Multi-market shared-object contention
metadata.claim_boundary: shared-authority contention and exactly-once behavior; no universal scalability claim

research_question: As authorized market count and per-market concurrency increase, does competition for one shared MetaToken, one last issuance quota, or one RightToken remain constrained by a single authoritative pre-state without duplicate settlement or loser-state pollution?

cell_definition.market_assignment: each market contributes exactly concurrency_per_market contenders
cell_definition.submission_order: deterministic seed-derived permutation; actual outcome is reconstructed by included block, extrinsic index, and event index

actor_derivation.market_accounts: derive and record 8 AccountId32 values from //R2//X2//Market//<1..8> under sr25519-substrate-v1
actor_derivation.buyer_accounts: derive and record 64 AccountId32 values from //R2//X2//Buyer//<1..64>
actor_derivation.funding: OWNER funds every active derived account to the frozen target balance before the fixture anchor
actor_derivation.authorization: all active market slots receive identical operation capability and object-level authorization before contention begins

scenarios.shared_resource: one tradable MetaToken with no active RightToken
scenarios.competition_boundary: authorized markets submit complete create/fund/settle sequences for the same MetaToken
scenarios.expected_terminal_rule: at most one Settled order and one final buyer owner

scenarios.shared_resource: one IssueRightAuthorization with available_count=1 and available_units sufficient for exactly one order
scenarios.competition_boundary: all contender orders are Open before concurrent fund_order submissions; only the uniquely Funded order may settle
scenarios.expected_terminal_rule: at most one issued RightToken; issued + reserved never exceeds the authorization maximum

scenarios.shared_resource: one active transferable RightToken with no use reservation or dispute
scenarios.competition_boundary: authorized markets submit complete create/fund/settle sequences for the same RightToken
scenarios.expected_terminal_rule: at most one Settled order and one final buyer holder

controls.object_and_authorization_pre_state: identical normalized fixture per scenario cell
controls.reset: fresh isolated fixture before each repetition
controls.missing_common_capability_policy: blocked; never N/A or synthetic failure
controls.architecture_specific_metric_policy: N/A only when the metric boundary is structurally absent; never encode N/A as zero

expected_result_rules: A competition group may have zero or one successful settlement but never more than one.
If a successful settlement exists, exactly one matching SettlementRecord and exactly one normalized success event must exist; otherwise both counts are zero.
Every losing attempt must add no business-state mutation, SettlementRecord, or success event relative to its actual included-order pre-state after dispatch fee normalization.
For last-quota contention, issued + reserved must never exceed the authorization maximum and at most one RightToken may be created.
A timeout never counts as an expected rejection and invalidates the cell.
stop_gates: E0 or the frozen I1-I10 prerequisite gate is not PASS
workload, fixture, checker, or schema changes after preflight
missing included block, extrinsic index, event index, or actual pre-state for any live attempt
more than one successful settlement in a competition group
issued + reserved exceeds the authorization maximum
a required common capability is missing
